permissions.pane.cwd: to show the folder the pane you're working in is in, and follow you when you switch panes or cd

permissions.fs.list: to show the names of the files and folders in it, one folder at a time (never what's in them)

permissions.viewer.open: to open the file you click in Tilefold's document viewer

permissions.page: to show the tree in a window of its own
